newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures surge to daily limits by close.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures surge to daily limits by close.

text.p: All months of Tokyo corn futures surged by their daily limit of 400 yen per tonne as buying interest accelerated ahead of the close on Thursday, backed by sharp gains in soybean futures, traders said.
The most-active benchmark January 1998 contract ended at 16,090 yen.
Activity was buoyant, with an estimated daily daily volume of 167,434 lots.
"Private investors are putting more money in volatile grain futures markets after closing positions in the sluggish rubber futures market," one trader said.
